exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
Place of birth (health facility vs. home)
Maternal knowledge of newborn danger signs
outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding (within 1 hour of birth)
cohort: 889 women who had given birth within 2 years preceding the survey in three rural districts of Tanzania
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding was significantly lower following caesarean section compared to vaginal birth, but higher among women who gave birth in health facilities compared to those who gave birth at home.
mod_finding: The odds of early initiation of breastfeeding was significantly 78% lower following childbirth by caesarean section than vaginal birth.
